turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
I'm listening, Hale. Who decided on the zero, and was Owen spoken to before it went in?
An answer to what, Hale? You haven't shown me anything yet, and nobody called me before that zero went in. I have until 4:40.
Either Owen admits it in writing by Friday at 3 PM or the zero goes on his transcript.

"Owen admits it in writing by Friday at 3 PM." I'm writing that down, word for word. Which section of your own procedure lets you demand a confession, and what exactly do you have that says he needs to make one?
Those are the only two options. Pick one.

There's a third option, and it's in your own procedure: 4.3 says software alone doesn't establish a concern. Owen isn't signing a confession for something he didn't do. Withdraw the zero, or I'm in the principal's office when we're done.
